claim_boundary.note: A gap in an attempted route is not a refutation of an existing theorem. This work found no fatal error in an accepted closure proof for these four targets.

results.strongest_result: For every integer x, v2(A_(2m)(x))=-v2(m!) when m is odd, and v2(A_(4s)(x))=2s-v2(s!) when s is odd. Together with round 8 this proves the polynomial-part law for v2(l)<=2. On the first missing layer, C_(4s) is divisible by 4 for odd s and by 8 for odd s>=3; exact Mahler identities additionally prove the isolated cases v2(A_8)=6 and v2(A_16)=14.
results.remaining_gap: The first two uniform Cartier divisibility steps on the first missing layer are proved (C_(4s) is divisible by 4 for odd s and by 8 for odd s>=3), but the full target valuation and doubling congruence remain open; even those would still not supply uniform control over variable l in the original equation.
results.verification: even_l_two_layers.py; exact Fraction arithmetic; default scan 1536 theorem evaluations, four proved third-layer seed regressions, and 2032 explicitly unproved Cartier probe cases, zero failures

results.strongest_result: Every independent complete lower fibre of size r has r distinct in-range canonical odd neighbours: its base and the upper neighbours of all but its least-exponent point. Within any fixed 2-adic layer, all canonical cross-fibre collisions form disjoint directed paths with no branching or cycles.
results.remaining_gap: Canonical neighbours collide across fibres, already on the independent chain (24,42,54); proper-divisor neighbours and a terminating augmenting-path theorem are still required.
results.verification: chain_fibre_audit.py; 276 independent subfibres and 58 fixed-layer canonical collisions through N=500, zero failures; exact global naive-injection counterexample

results.strongest_result: Every nonzero integer polynomial divisible by (1-u)^m has coefficient-square energy at least 2m. Consequently E(P)>=2 m_q S_q(P/(1-z^q)^m_q) for every divisor direction q. Equality chains are exactly disjoint ideal Prouhet-Tarry-Escott pairs of size m; energy excess 2D permits at most D non-equality residue fibres.
results.remaining_gap: No simultaneous residue inverse theorem forces m_q S_q/n to grow or excludes many compatible ideal Prouhet-Tarry-Escott fibres; q=1 gives exactly the known 2n energy boundary.
results.verification: residue_root_energy_audit.py; 5004 exponent multisets, 26927 divisor rows, and 12809 equality-chain inverse checks, zero failures

results.strongest_result: Within the uniform-density AP-window plus universal wrap-decoder architecture, window width rho and packing give g+log2(M)<=log2(N)-log2(k)+O(1); widening the window only transfers the unavoidable log k loss from fibre density to decoder capacity. The packing lemma holds in every finite abelian group, so a naive direct product of several moduli has the same loss.
results.remaining_gap: An O(1)-loss recursion needs a genuinely different decoder using actual reachable wraps or zero-fibre structure, rather than universal avoidance in one modulus or a direct product of moduli.
results.verification: general cyclic-gap proof in REPORT.md; the endpoint packing calculation was independently audited in round 2
